title: Every Space gets a public address hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com that receives into Conversations and sends as the Space
detail: BUILT 2026-10-12 (switch off). Owner ruling 2026-10-12: every account that messages through Frequency can have a reply address at their Space, like hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com; premium can use its own domain. Table space_inbox_addresses (migration 20270346008400, service-only, pgTAP supabase/tests/space_inbox_addresses.test.sql). Provisioning lib/comms/space-inbox-address.ts: Resend domain <slug>.<SPACE_EMAIL_INBOX_ROOT> with receiving on (lib/spaces/email-domain-provider.ts createEmailProviderInboxDomain, findEmailProviderDomainByName), its MX/SPF/DKIM written into the root zone by lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts upsertZoneDnsRecords, row stored before DNS, idempotent, never throws; checkSpaceInboxAddress re-reads the provider. Inbound: lib/comms/inbound.ts resolves the Space address BEFORE the EMAIL-013 alias; a verified address opens a NEW Space conversation with the sender as a contact (consent unknown, source space_inbox); unknown, pending, failed or paused quarantines (inbox_address_unknown / inbox_address_unverified). Outbound: resolveSpaceEmailDefaultIdentity falls back to the verified inbox From for conversations on every plan (custom identity still wins; campaigns unchanged). Surface: the Your Space address card on Space Settings > Email (components/spaces/email/space-inbox-address-setup.tsx, actions app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/email/inbox-actions.ts), hidden while SPACE_INBOX_ADDRESSES_ENABLED is off. Switches and gate: .env.example, docs/RUNBOOKS.md Space inbox address (EMAIL-022). OPEN until: the migration is applied, SPACE_EMAIL_INBOX_ROOT and the Vercel DNS token are set for the frequencylocal.com zone, the Resend account webhook carries email.received, the pilot on the Daniel Tyack Space receives one outside mail into a new conversation and replies from hello@<slug>.frequencylocal.com, and the switch is on in production with that evidence appended here.

verify.evidence: OPEN. Probe runs the pure core (address, matcher, zone records, state, From) and reads the inbound-before-alias and From-fallback seams; vitest lib/comms/space-inbox-address.test.ts (provisioning idempotence and fail-safe, routing, recording), lib/comms/inbound-space-inbox.test.ts (webhook branch), lib/spaces/email-domain-onboarding.test.ts (From fallback) pass locally. Not yet observed: the migration in production, a real Resend domain reaching verified, a real inbound mail, the switch on. The probe closes only when this evidence carries "SWITCH ON IN PRODUCTION <date>" and "PILOT OBSERVED".
